```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
library(ggsql)
library(openintro)
data(lego_population)

# Create an in-memory DuckDB reader
reader <- duckdb_reader()

# Register a dataset in it
ggsql_register(reader, lego_population, "legodata")
```

### Visualize it with a query


```{r}
ggsql_execute(
  reader,
  "VISUALISE price AS x, unique_pieces AS y, theme AS fill FROM (SELECT * FROM legodata
  WHERE theme IN ('City', 'Friends', 'Marvel'))
  DRAW point"
)
```
